name: Gemini Personal Intelligence
desc: Gemini capability that uses your apps and chats to personalize answers
desc_zh: 结合你的应用和对话来个性化回答的 Gemini 能力
solves: Generic answers ignore your calendar and mail; Personal Intelligence draws on your connected apps to tailor them.
solves_zh: 通用回答不了解你的日程和邮件，Personal Intelligence 会结合你的数据作答。
best_for: You ask whether you are free for dinner without opening your calendar.
best_for_zh: 想问晚上有没有空吃饭，又不想自己去翻日历。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://gemini.google/release-notes (official Gemini Apps release updates)）。 Outside the window. Entry dated 2026.01.20; beta for Google AI Pro and AI Ultra subscribers in the US. It later powers Daily Brief and comes to Search and cars. Second source is not independent media. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Personal Intelligence」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://gemini.google/release-notes
